column1: # skillmap.tsv — the single answer to "installed where, and why".
# Collapses four sources that used to disagree: skillinstall.sh case entries,
# Machine-first on purpose — skillctl reads it, and one grep answers a question
# that used to take four file reads.
# name        the registry directory under skills/ (must contain SKILL.md)
# targets     comma-separated deploy targets, or "-" for backup-only (most
#             adopted skills: registered so they are backed up, not deployed)
# owner       "self" when this repo authors it, else the path of the repo that
#             does — those are MIRRORED here and edited there
